{"id": "73:4", "words": "E se gloriaram ... no meio da vossa solenidade", "readings": ["the enemies boasted in the middle of your feast/assembly", "the enemies boasted in the middle of your sacred place (solemnity as the place of worship)"], "likelyHeard": "they boasted during your feast day"},

{"id": "73:6", "words": "Como numa selva de árvores", "readings": ["as woodsmen do in a forest, they hacked the doors", "the doors were like a thicket of trees"], "likelyHeard": "a simile of chopping as in a forest"},
